topics.title: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers: Soumya's visit to the National War Memorial

concepts.learning_objective: Recall key facts about the National War Memorial and explain why such memorials matter.
Identify India's gallantry awards and interpret the citations of the heroes named in the letter.

topics.title: The four Chakras and the Amar Jawan Jyoti

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the four concentric circles of the memorial and what each symbolises.
Explain the meaning of the Amar Jawan Jyoti and the obelisk with the eternal flame.
Interpret Ananda's views on war memorials and our duty to honour soldiers.
Recall details of Ananda's letter such as the Chandigarh memorial and her hobby of philately.

topics.title: Let us learn: prefixes and subordinate clauses

concepts.learning_objective: Form and understand words made with prefixes such as dis-, in-, im-, un-, re- and de-.
Identify main and subordinate clauses and use subordinating conjunctions correctly.

topics.title: My Dear Soldiers (poem by A.P.J. Abdul Kalam)

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the poet, theme and tone of the poem 'My Dear Soldiers'.
Recognise and interpret poetic devices such as simile and metaphor in the poem.
Choose words that collocate naturally, as practised with the poem.

topics.title: Rani Abbakka: the queen of Ullal

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how and why Rani Abbakka defied the Portuguese.
Understand the meanings of words from the story such as vassal and defied.

topics.title: Spelling, silent letters and reported speech

concepts.learning_objective: Apply the 'ie/ei' spelling rule and recognise silent letters.
Change direct speech into indirect speech with the correct changes of tense, person, time and place.
